name: brain
description: Query, set up and feed your company's BrainBox brain: recall from the domain model, traces and wiki; ingest databases and docs; run workflows; score and upgrade.

interface.longDescription: Connects to the BrainBox MCP server to query project domain models, intelligence traces, wiki pages, skills and live data tools, with skills for setup, ingestion, workflows, scoring and upgrades.
defaultPrompt: Ask my BrainBox brain what it knows about a business topic, entity, workflow, or recent event
